parsed.name: 通用SCPI仪器
parsed.description: 支持SCPI命令控制的通用实验室电子仪器，可代表频谱仪、信号源、示波器、源表等多种台式测量设备。此类仪器常用于实验室自动化测试、参数配置、状态查询和测量数据采集。
parsed.description_en: A generic laboratory electronic instrument that accepts SCPI commands. It can represent many benchtop test and measurement devices, such as spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes, or source meters, and is commonly used for automated testing, parameter configuration, status queries, and measurement data acquisition in laboratories.

actions.description: 向仪器发送查询命令并读取返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send a query command to the instrument and read back the response.

actions.description_en: Set the timeout and polling interval used while waiting for instrument operation complete (OPC).
